release: 1.96.0
LLVM version: 22.1.2
sampling: Five batches of at least 100ms after warmup; median. Native and Python timings include result destruction. JavaScript timings include ordinary GC when triggered, without forced GC.
wasm_main_comparison: No wasm-opt on either main SDK benchmark artifact; post-link optimization measured separately.
wasm_flag_experiment: Same baseline bindgen artifact, wasm-opt -Oz versus -O3, --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --strip-producers.
baseline_confirmation: Preserved baseline executables were rerun to check drift and cover the newly discovered nested-query case. Competing review compiler/test processes were paused during those runs.

commands.python_build_macos: PYO3_PYTHON=<python> cargo rustc -p polyglot-sql-python --profile performance --offline -- -C link-arg=-undefined -C link-arg=dynamic_lookup
commands.wasm_build: CARGO_PROFILE_PERFORMANCE_PANIC=abort cargo build -p polyglot-sql-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --profile performance --offline
commands.browser_smoke: Start playground Vite preview on 127.0.0.1:4174 and isolated headless Chrome with debugging port 9223, then node tools/bench-compare/performance_browser_smoke.mjs

environment_notes: A separate debug Python verification build required -C strip=none -C link-arg=-Wl,-x for the macOS 27 loader issue https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/157750 . Both final benchmark extensions used the same unmodified performance-profile strip setting.
bridge_experiment: Compared direct serde_wasm_bindgen AST queries against JSON exports in the same prototype SDK. Retained JSON: faster in every measured case. The rejected WASM export is archived in bridge-prototype.patch; performance_bridge.mjs requires that experimental export.
final_benchmark_conditions: Native, Python and SDK benchmarks ran sequentially without competing review builds or test runs. The isolated browser was closed before final Python/SDK runs.
wasm_size_measurement: Bindgen WASM files from the main comparison; no wasm-opt. gzip.compress(level=9). These are not production-release bundle sizes.
